follows.conclusion: single authority removes contradictions, but legacy semanticRole projection cannot distinguish navigation from region structure

normativeDefinitions.definition: Identifies the document, report, or artifact itself as its semantic title identity.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike METADATA, it is the title identity rather than a description of the artifact.

normativeDefinitions.definition: Names or opens a semantic region whose subsequent content belongs beneath it.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike NAVIGATION, OBJECT_CAPTION, and TABLE_STRUCTURE, it opens a region rather than pointing elsewhere or describing an internal object/table part.

normativeDefinitions.definition: Points to, lists, or leads to content elsewhere in the document.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike REGION_STRUCTURE, it does not open a region whose following content belongs beneath it.

normativeDefinitions.definition: Serves repeated or page-positioned presentation, such as a running header, footer, or page number.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike REGION_STRUCTURE, its function is page presentation, not opening a content region.

normativeDefinitions.definition: Names or describes an embedded visual, figure, listing, or other object whose scope is that object itself.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike REGION_STRUCTURE, it does not open a broader following content region.

normativeDefinitions.definition: Is a row, column, label, or header structure internal to a table.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike REGION_STRUCTURE, it is internal to the table rather than a heading outside or around it that opens a broader region.

normativeDefinitions.definition: Is a footnote, citation, attribution, or source note that supports or qualifies other content.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike REGION_STRUCTURE, it does not establish a region for subsequent body content.

normativeDefinitions.definition: Is ordinary body information, such as prose, a statement, or a run-in fact, without a region-opening function.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike REGION_STRUCTURE, it conveys content but does not name or open the region containing it.

normativeDefinitions.definition: Describes the document, its provenance, status, date, audience, or other attributes without constituting its title identity.
normativeDefinitions.boundary: Unlike DOCUMENT_IDENTITY, it describes the artifact but is not the artifact's semantic title identity.

primarySemanticFunction.occurrenceNotString: identical or overlapping text may have different functions at different source occurrences and contexts

sourceParts.description: The existing source-coordinate tuple; its binder and canonicalization are unchanged by this design.

semanticFunction.description: The sole authority from which membership is derived.
